violation_type.title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment Including Hitting with Hand or Instrument (26 TAC §742.603(a))
violation_type.short_title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment Including Hitting with Hand or Instrument
violation_type.typical_finding: During the investigation, it was determined that the caregiver threatened a child with corporal punishment if they moved from the couch.
